detail: 260 passed, 2 skipped, 2 failed: tests/test_supervised_batch.py (both tests, Linux only). All other 18 checks PASS.
cause: Real defect in the new batch supervisor on POSIX: a killed parent that its own parent has not yet reaped is a zombie, which psutil.pid_exists / kill(pid, 0) still report as alive, so neither the supervisor (watching its wrapper) nor supervised_entry (watching the supervisor) noticed the death. Windows was unaffected (process handles report exit).
fix: POSIX detection by reparenting (os.getppid() != recorded parent) plus zombie status; scripts/run_supervised_batch.py and scripts/lib/supervised_entry.py. Both tests then pass on Windows and in WSL; documented commands rerun in a fresh directory.
